name: Access Revoke Request Submitted For Requested-For Identity
description: Sent to the identity whose access is being reviewed in an access revoke request.
subject: $requesterName has requested to revoke your access
body:
Access revoke request submitted

Hello ${requestedForIdentityName},

$requesterName has requested removal of your access from the items listed below. If approvals are required, you will be notified when a decision is made.

#foreach ( $type in ${requestedObjectDetailsByType.keySet()} )

$type

    #foreach ( $detail in ${requestedObjectDetailsByType.get($type)} )
  • ${detail.name} #if($detail.removeDate)(sunset date: ${detail.removeDate})#end
    • #end
#end

If you need more information about this request, please contact $requesterName.

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
